description: Compares the annual tax on a UK rental property held personally (Section 24 rules) against holding it in a limited company (corporation tax, then dividend tax on profit extracted). Returns net profit and effective tax rate for each structure and which one pays less this year.

annualOperatingCosts.description: Annual allowable costs excluding mortgage interest, in GBP.

annualRent.description: Gross annual rental income in GBP.

dividendAmount.description: Dividends taken out of the company per year in GBP. Omit to extract all post-tax profit.

personalTaxBand.description: The landlord's income tax band: basic (20%), higher (40%) or additional (45%).

name: compare_personal_vs_company_ownership
title: Compare personal vs limited company
